turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.

Hello, I can help you with a delivery change. Please send me the order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used when you placed the order. Then tell me the new address you want the parcel sent to.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. I checked order SC-3360 and it has already shipped. Under our policy, the delivery address can only be changed until the order ships, so I can't change it now. You can follow the parcel with the tracking link from your order details, and the courier can tell you more about delivery. Is there anything else I can help with?

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: That new address is the one I need used.

I understand this matters to you, but I can't change the address on SC-3360. The order has already shipped, and our policy only allows address changes before shipping, so the parcel will continue to the address used at checkout. If you want, you can ask the courier about redirecting it using the tracking link in your order details.
